hero.title: GeoAnalyzer
hero.subtitle: Intelligent urban environment analysis system for informed decision-making

mission.text_1: This is an intelligent response to the opacity of the real estate market. We demonstrate that quality of life and comfort are not subjective feelings, but measurable indicators. Our platform transforms millions of raw urban data points into precise analytical ratings.
mission.text_2: We are setting a new standard for urban analytics. Our goal is to provide every user, from tenants to strategic investors, with tools to deeply understand infrastructure, safety, and potential of any district.

features.title: Social Infrastructure
features.text: In-depth analysis of educational and medical networks. We evaluate not only the number of schools and hospitals but also their real accessibility and density per capita.

features.title: Transport & Mobility
features.text: Comprehensive mobility assessment: from proximity to metro and tram lines to bike lane coverage and parking availability.

features.title: Safety & Law Enforcement
features.text: Monitoring crime rates, street lighting quality, and CCTV coverage to ensure your safety.

features.title: Environment & Urban Space
features.text: Objective data on air quality, noise pollution, greenery percentage, and availability of recreational zones within walking distance.

features.title: Commercial Potential
features.text: Market saturation analysis: from grocery chains and malls to bank branches and dining establishments.

features.title: Economic Indicators
features.text: Analytics of property prices per square meter, rental trends, and average salaries in the district for accurate ROI calculations.

process.title: Geographic Focus
process.text: Use the interactive map to instantly select a city or outline a specific search area within Poland.

process.title: Intelligent Scoring
process.text: The algorithm automatically analyzes the location across 50+ Big Data parameters and generates detailed environmental quality ratings.

process.title: Comparative Analytics
process.text: Compare multiple districts side by side to identify hidden advantages and critical drawbacks of each location.

process.title: Final Assessment & Report
process.text: Receive a comprehensive analysis of value, infrastructure, and risks in a convenient format for informed decision-making.

data_sources.title: Methodology & Data Processing:
items: Multi-level verification and cleaning of raw data
Daily updates of dynamic indicators (prices, environment)
Geospatial linking of infrastructure objects to district boundaries
Intelligent anomaly detection and validation by analysts

audience.title: Individuals
audience.text: For those seeking the perfect balance of price and quality of life. Find a quiet neighborhood with schools or a lively city center for youth.

audience.title: Private Investors
audience.text: Minimize risks based on hard data rather than intuition. Evaluate the growth potential of district capitalization.

audience.title: Realtors & Agencies
audience.text: Enhance your expertise in the eyes of clients. Use our professional reports (White Label).

audience.title: Developers
audience.text: Analyze competitive environment and infrastructure needs of a district before starting construction.

cta.title: Make Decisions Based on Facts
cta.text: Join thousands of users who have already found their ideal space
